cross_definition: Every candidate target seat versus every other saved arm's opposite seat in the same game/seed. Fine own best response fixes that same opposite-seat policy. Diagonal conditions reproduce the already audited source responses; off-diagonals are new own-calculated diagnostics, not an independent native audit.
row_definition: Saved prefix reach and exact own best-reply suffix. Sum all owned-row losses to unilateral gain; group and street sums must match. This is fixed-profile accounting, not causal retraining or abstraction EV loss.
failures: Retain completed-profile partials and finite diagnostics on failure. Refuse existing output directories. No favorable seed, arm, seat or row subset replaces the complete declared inventory.
